title: Little Lenny and the Big Ocean Problem
dedication: This book is dedicated to Mother Earth. May we teach our children to love, honor, and care for her and all her inhabitants.

paragraphs: Little Lenny sat in the warm sand on the beach, digging in the sand and filling the holes with ocean water. As he ran back to the ocean waves to fill his bucket, he saw his dad picking up something from the ground.
He ran as fast as he could to see what his dad was finding! His bucket sloshed around, spilling water along the beach as he ran. “Dad! What are you finding?”, Lenny asked excitedly, out of breath.
Lenny’s dad looks up and laughs, “I am picking up this trash I found, Lenny! Would you like to help me?”
Lenny stops and stares up at his dad and then glances down at the plastic water bottle in his dad’s hands.
“That isn’t our trash! Why are you picking it up?”, Lenny asks, curiously.
“You are right, Lenny, this is not our trash. But I want to pick it up so that the beach will be clean.”, his dad replied.
Lenny looked around the beach, confused. “Why can’t we just leave it there? It doesn’t seem to be bothering anyone!”

“Well, we could just leave it there, but there is a lot of sea life that could be harmed if we all just left our trash on the beach.”, Lenny listened to his dad intently. “Eventually all of this beach trash will end up in the oceans. There is a lot of life in the ocean that we do not see, and they do not want to swim in our trash.”
“It can make them very sick. It also hurts our water and air.”, Lenny’s dad continued.
Lenny looked out to the ocean and sighed, “I want to help them. I will help pick up the trash!”

“That is great, Lenny! I am so proud of you!”, his dad replied. Lenny had already run off to pick up a bottle he saw a few feet away. Lenny ran around the beach, happily picking up trash and running it back to put it in the trash bag his dad was holding.
After only a few minutes they had already cleaned up all the trash they could see in that part of the beach. Lenny looked around, proud of their work.
The next day, Lenny and his family returned to the beach. He ran quickly out to the sand, expecting to see the clean beach they had worked so hard on the day before.
He stopped suddenly and looked around. There were a lot of people enjoying the beach, and there was already so much trash laying around again.
Lenny suddenly became very sad. He turned around and said, “Dad! It is filled with trash again! What do we do?”. He felt very discouraged and sat down, dropping his bucket and shovel next to him.
“It’s ok, Lenny! Don’t get discouraged!”, his dad said, kneeling beside him. “Why don’t we play a little bit and then we can clean up before we leave, just like we did yesterday?”.

Lenny lifted his head and looked up at his dad, “I am just so worried about the sea animals, Dad. We can’t pick up all the trash, there is so much!”. He kicked the sand around with his feet, staring at the ground.

“Lenny, I understand why you are frustrated. It feels like a very big problem, but if we all help just a little bit, doing what we can, that makes the problem easier to deal with.”, he said, placing his arm around Lenny.
“It’s important in life to leave everything and everyone better than you found them.”

Lenny leaned into his Dad for a moment, looking around the beach. Suddenly, he jumped up and proclaimed proudly, “That’s it! We just have to get everyone to help! Come on, Dad, let’s go tell them about the sea animals! I know they will help if they hear the danger the animals are in!”.
Lenny ran off, picking up pieces of trash as he went. His dad ran behind him, trying to keep up.

Lenny would run from piece of trash to piece of trash, quickly spotting the next one. He wasn’t watching where he was going as he ran across a sunbather’s towel, or through a group of kids building a sandcastle.
His dad ran behind him, apologizing to the beach-goers for his son’s sandy path, left in his wake. “Lenny! Slow down! We don’t have to pick up all the trash at once!”
Lenny stopped and turned around, looking at his dad confused. “Yes we do, Dad! We have to also tell all these people about the sea life! They are in danger!”.

Lenny ran off again, stopping at each group on the beach, showing them the dirty water bottle he had found, explaining how it could harm a sea turtle or sea lion. Most of the groups politely nodded along, smiling at the small boy, so full of passion.
But some beach-goers were not as interested in Lenny’s desperate message. One woman, lying on her back, sunning herself on a bright beach towel turns and shushes Lenny.

Lenny stood staring at the crowd, realizing no one had gotten up to pick up any of the trash on the beach. Even though he told them about the animals and water and the pollution. No one was stopping their surfing or sandcastle building or picnicking.
He felt hopeless standing there, seeing there was so much more trash still to clean, and realizing there would be even more tomorrow. And no one seemed to care!!
Lenny dropped the water bottle on the sand and sat down. He stared at the sand, feeling defeated.
Lenny’s dad walked up to him and knelt down beside him. “It’s ok, buddy. You can’t solve the whole big ocean problem on your own! No one can do it alone.”
“But, they don’t seem to care, Dad. They didn’t want to help.”, Lenny replied, still staring at the sand.
Lenny’s dad put his hand on his son’s shoulder and tried to think of what he could say to help Lenny feel better.

Suddenly, an aluminum can popped up from behind them and dropped on the ground next to them. Lenny reached over and picked it up and put it in his trash bag. He kept his head down, still feeling overwhelmed by the big ocean problem.
Another can popped up behind them and dropped between them. Lenny went to grab that one when several water bottles popped up and dropped around them.
Lenny and his dad turn around to see where all this trash is suddenly coming from. They turned around to the ocean behind them, and thats when they saw it!
There was a dolphin! His head was bobbing up out of the ocean waves. He seemed to be smiling at Lenny.
Lenny and his dad looked at each other and then back at the dolphin, completely in awe.
The dolphin dove back in the water and then just as quickly, popped back up with a piece of trash on his head. The dolphin popped up higher and tossed the trash right into Lenny’s trash bag.
“It looks like you found some help!”, Lenny’s dad laughed, pointing at the dolphin.
They ran around picking them up as quickly as they could, laughing as they went. As they got closer to the ocean, the dolphins would get closer to the beach.
Lenny suddenly ran into the ocean with his bag to get a bottle that was floating away with the waves, his dad running behind.
Lenny’s dad caught up to him and grabbed him just in time to miss the wave crashing in. He felt a strong pull in the water at his feet. He put Lenny on his shoulders and looked down.
One of the dolphins was looking back up at him, which was quite surprising!
Lenny and his dad both pointed at the dolphin with excitement, but just as quickly, the wave swirled around them and they found themselves in a fast moving current, being taken out to sea.
The pod of dolphins were creating a bubble of air for them to breathe as they were taken on quite a journey.
The dolphins communicated with Lenny and his dad inside their heads, making them feel calm and safe.
Lenny and his dad started to see why the dolphins had taken them on this adventure. They went down deep to the bottom of the ocean floor and saw piles of trash.
They went to coral reefs and saw dying coral and more trash.
They were taken through a group of sea turtles, some who have permanent damage from getting stuck in pieces of trash in the ocean.
They saw schools of fish who are hungry and homeless because trash has taken over their ecosystems.
There was so much trash in the ocean!! The sea life was trying to live around it. They were trying so hard to survive, despite the trash!
This made Lenny and his dad so sad! The dolphins could sense the sadness of the boy and his father. Lenny and his dad could sense the sadness of the dolphins and other sea life.

As the dolphins returned them to the beach where they met, Lenny asked the dolphin pod, “What can we do? How can we help?”. He had tears in his eyes and looked down at his small bag of trash. He realized how many more bags were needed to hold all the trash he saw in the ocean.
The dolphin looked into Lenny’s eyes, smiled, and dropped back into the ocean.

Lenny looked up at his dad with panic. Lenny’s dad laughed as the dolphin popped back up with a few pieces of trash balanced on his nose. He tossed them into the air and they all landed, one after another, in Lenny’s trash bag. The dolphin smiled, waved his fin in the air, and dove back down into the ocean.

Lenny laughed, picked up the trash bag, and walked off with it over his shoulder. As he walked, he picked up the trash he saw along the way. He was smiling because he now understood that if everyone just helped a little bit, doing what they can, things would get better.
